text: Given a request to any tool without the X-Notion-Api-Key header, When the server handles it, Then it returns HTTP 401 listing the missing header
Given a valid API key, When notion_search is called with a text query, Then it returns matching pages/databases with id, object, title, url, last_edited_time
Given a result set larger than limit, When notion_search is called with a small limit, Then has_more is true and next_cursor is usable to continue
Given an accessible page id, When notion_get_page is called, Then it returns id, parent, archived flag, url, and flattened properties
Given a non-existent or unshared page id, When notion_get_page is called, Then it returns code: not_found
Given a parent database id and valid properties, When notion_create_page is called, Then a new page is created and its id and url are returned
Given a property value of the wrong type for the target database schema, When notion_create_page is called, Then it returns code: invalid_argument
Given an existing page, When notion_update_page sets archived true then archived false, Then the page is trashed then restored (round-trips, not permanently lost)
Given a database id, When notion_get_database is called, Then it returns the property schema (name, type, type-specific config)
Given a database id with and without a filter, When notion_query_database is called, Then it returns all pages (no filter) or only matching pages (with filter), paginated
Given a page/block id with mixed child block types, When notion_list_block_children is called, Then each child's type and plain text are returned, paginated if many
Given a list of supported block types, When notion_append_block_children is called, Then the blocks are appended and their created ids are returned
Given a list containing one unsupported block type, When notion_append_block_children is called, Then it returns code: invalid_argument naming that type and nothing is appended
Given a workspace, When notion_list_users is called, Then it returns users (id, name, person/bot type), paginated
Given Notion returns 429 with Retry-After, When any tool is called, Then the server retries honoring the delay, and returns code: rate_limited (never a raw 429/529) once retries are exhausted
Given a result set that would exceed the 20000-character response cap, When a list/query tool is called, Then the response is truncated with has_more/next_cursor set, never an unbounded payload

Given two concurrent requests for two different tenants (two different X-Notion-Api-Key values) hitting the same container, When both are in flight at once, Then neither request's data or credential is visible to the other (security/multi-tenant isolation anchor)
Given the server is running, When tools/list is called, Then it returns exactly the 9 documented tools, each with a description <= 500 chars (first line <= 100), and read tools carry readOnlyHint

Given a real Notion internal integration token shared with one disposable test page and one test database, When the full create/get/update(archive+restore)/search/query/append/list-children path is run end to end, Then every step succeeds against the live API
steps: Obtain a real Notion internal integration token and share it with one disposable page and one disposable database
notion_create_page under the test database with a couple of properties
notion_get_page on the created page id, confirm properties match
notion_search for the page's title, confirm it is found
notion_query_database on the test database, confirm the created page is among the results
notion_append_block_children with a paragraph and a bulleted list item on the created page
notion_list_block_children on the created page, confirm the appended blocks are present
notion_update_page with archived: true, then again with archived: false, confirm restore
expect: Every step returns the shape documented in the Tech design 'Data & API contract' section; no step surfaces a raw Notion error instead of the mapped envelope
notes: needs a real vendor account (Notion internal integration token) -- does not block reaching 6b/6c per vendor-mcp-development SOP 'no test account is not a blocker'
